name: Sketch Dissolve
description: The first clip fades back to blank paper while the second is drawn on it in pencil, outlines first and then hatching in the shadows, before its shading and colors fill in until the picture is complete. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: line_width
params.description: Thickness of the pencil outlines, in thousandths of the frame height

params.name: edges
params.description: How many outlines are drawn: higher also traces the fainter edges of the picture

params.name: hatching
params.description: Amount of diagonal hatching drawn in the shadows
